correctness.rationale: The covariant Choi decomposition has multiplicity-one spin sectors; the positive trace-preserving covariant maps are convex combinations of their normalized channels. The recorded 6j symmetry gives u_L^(k)=u_k^(L). An independent low-rank check uses C(X)=∑J_i X J_i, whose eigenvalue on V_k is a-s/2 by the commutator Casimir, with a=j(j+1) and s=k(k+1). The rank-one channel is C/a. For Q_ij=(J_iJ_j+J_jJ_i)/2-δ_ij aI/3, the Kraus map ∑Q_ij X Q_ij is proportional to the rank-two extreme channel by covariance and support. Multiplying left and right spin actions (with opposite commutation signs) gives C²-C/2-a²/3, normalized by a(4a-3)/6 at the identity. Substituting C=a-s/2 and exchanging k and L reproduces the two multipliers. The resulting projected supporting inequality has slack 3s(s-2)/(2a(4a-3))≥0; this is a facet of the two-multiplier projection, not of the full simplex when 2j>2. At the semigroup identity, differentiating gives γ₂≤3γ₁. Every putative generator commutes with its exponential, and the coherent multipole eigenvalues are positive and distinct, so it preserves every multipole block. On the real Hermitian blocks det(exp(τL))=exp(τ tr L) fixes the real trace. Twirling the generator (not its exponential) retains the GKSL property and each block trace, and complex Schur's lemma on each irreducible operator block gives scalar log(λ_L)/τ. Thus the bound applies even to noncovariant proposed generators, with no assumption on logarithm branches. The spectrum from the coherent overlap integral gives λ₁=n/(n+2) and λ₂=n(n-1)/[(n+2)(n+3)]; direct subtraction gives the stated positive gap for n≥2 and the log expansion follows. At j=1/2 the rank-one commutator Casimir is 2, so the isotropic double commutator with coefficient -log(3)/2 realizes λ₁=1/3. Spin zero is outside the statement (and would give the identity). The reviewed frozen exact finite recoupling tests were not rerun and do not establish the infinite-spin or noncovariant argument. No time-dependent or ancilla-assisted obstruction is established.
